1138 GF_ASSERT(person == obj_partner_poke);
1139 return FALSE;
1140 }
1141 if (person == obj_partner_poke) {
1142 ov01_021F7704(object);
1143 }

1151BOOL ScrCmd_563(ScriptContext *ctx) {
1152 u16 person = ScriptGetVar(ctx);
1153 u16 x = ScriptGetVar(ctx);
1154 u16 z = ScriptGetVar(ctx);
1155 u16 now_x, now_z;
1156 int i;
1157 LocalMapObject *object = sub_02041C70(ctx->fieldSystem, person);
1158 MovementScriptCommand *cmd;
1159 EventObjectMovementMan *movementMan;
1160 u8 *movementCounter;
1161
1162 GF_ASSERT(object != NULL);
1163 cmd = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_FIELD1, 64 * sizeof(MovementScriptCommand));
1164 now_x = MapObject_GetXCoord(object);
1165 now_z = MapObject_GetZCoord(object);
1166 i = 0;
1167 if (now_x < x) {
1168 cmd[i].command = MOVEMENT_STEP_RIGHT;
1169 cmd[i].length = x - now_x;
1170 i++;
1171 } else if (now_x > x) {
1172 cmd[i].command = MOVEMENT_STEP_LEFT;
1173 cmd[i].length = now_x - x;
1174 i++;
1175 }
1176 if (now_z < z) {
1177 cmd[i].command = MOVEMENT_STEP_UP;
1178 cmd[i].length = z - now_z;
1179 i++;
1180 } else if (now_z > z) {
1181 cmd[i].command = MOVEMENT_STEP_DOWN;
1182 cmd[i].length = now_z - z;
1183 i++;
1184 }
1185 cmd[i].command = MOVEMENT_STEP_END;
1186 cmd[i].length = 0;
1187
1188 movementMan = EventObjectMovementMan_Create(object, cmd);
1189 movementCounter = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(ctx->fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_ACTIVE_MOVEMENT_COUNTER);
1190 (*movementCounter)++;
1191 _ScheduleObjectEventMovement(ctx->fieldSystem, movementMan, cmd);
1192 return FALSE;
1193}

1227void _ScheduleObjectEventMovement(FieldSystem *fieldSystem, EventObjectMovementMan *movementMan, MovementScriptCommand *a2) {

1239void _RunObjectEventMovement(SysTask *task, struct ObjectMovementTaskEnv *env) {
1240 u8 *movementCnt = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(env->fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_ACTIVE_MOVEMENT_COUNTER);
1241 if (EventObjectMovementMan_IsFinish(env->movementMan) == TRUE) {
1242 EventObjectMovementMan_Delete(env->movementMan);
1243 SysTask_Destroy(env->task);
1244 if (env->cmd != NULL) {
1245 Heap_Free(env->cmd);
1246 }
1247 Heap_Free(env);
1248 if (*movementCnt == 0) {
1249 GF_ASSERT(FALSE);

1251 (*movementCnt)--;
1252 }

1305 if (MapObject_IsMovementPaused(playerObj) == TRUE) {
1306 MapObject_PauseMovement(playerObj);
1307 _ClearMovementPauseWaitFlag(1);
1308 }
1309 }
1310
1311 if (_CheckMovementPauseWaitFlag(4)) {
1312 if (MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(*p_lastInteracted) == FALSE) {
1313 MapObject_PauseMovement(*p_lastInteracted);
1314 _ClearMovementPauseWaitFlag(4);
1315 }
1316 }
1317
1318 if (_CheckMovementPauseWaitFlag(2)) {
1319 unk = MapObjectManager_GetFirstActiveObjectWithMovement(fieldSystem->mapObjectManager, 0x30);
1320 if (MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(unk) == FALSE) {
1321 MapObject_PauseMovement(unk);
1322 _ClearMovementPauseWaitFlag(2);
1323 }
1324 }
1325
1326 if (_CheckMovementPauseWaitFlag(8)) {
1327 unk = sub_020660C0(*p_lastInteracted);
1328 if (MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(unk) == FALSE) {
1329 MapObject_PauseMovement(unk);
1330 _ClearMovementPauseWaitFlag(8);
1331 }
1332 }
1333
1334 return _AllMovementPauseWaitsFinish();
1335}

1347BOOL ScrCmd_LockLastTalked(ScriptContext *ctx) {
1348 FieldSystem *fieldSystem = ctx->fieldSystem;
1349 LocalMapObject **p_lastInteracted = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_LAST_INTERACTED);
1350 LocalMapObject *playerObject = PlayerAvatar_GetMapObject(fieldSystem->playerAvatar);
1351 LocalMapObject *unk = MapObjectManager_GetFirstActiveObjectWithMovement(fieldSystem->mapObjectManager, 0x30);
1352 LocalMapObject *unk2 = sub_020660C0(*p_lastInteracted);
1353 MapObjectManager *mapObjectManager = fieldSystem->mapObjectManager;
1354
1355 _ResetMovementPauseWaitFlags();
1356
1357 MapObjectManager_PauseAllMovement(mapObjectManager);
1358
1359 if (MapObject_IsMovementPaused(playerObject) == FALSE) {
1360 _SetMovementPauseWaitFlag(1);
1361 MapObject_UnpauseMovement(playerObject);
1362 }
1363
1364 if (MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(*p_lastInteracted) != FALSE) {
1365 _SetMovementPauseWaitFlag(4);
1366 MapObject_UnpauseMovement(*p_lastInteracted);
1367 }
1368
1369 if (unk != NULL && FollowMon_IsActive(fieldSystem) && MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(unk) == FALSE) {
1370 _SetMovementPauseWaitFlag(2);
1371 MapObject_UnpauseMovement(unk);
1372 }
1373
1374 if (unk2 != NULL && MapObject_CheckSingleMovement(unk2) != FALSE) {
1375 _SetMovementPauseWaitFlag(8);
1376 MapObject_UnpauseMovement(unk2);
1377 }
1378
1379 SetupNativeScript(ctx, _WaitMovementPauseBeforeMsg);
1380 return TRUE;
1381}

1475BOOL ScrCmd_FacePlayer(ScriptContext *ctx) {
1476 FieldSystem *fieldSystem = ctx->fieldSystem;
1477 u32 rvsDir = sub_020611F4(PlayerAvatar_GetFacingDirection(fieldSystem->playerAvatar));
1478 LocalMapObject **p_lastInteracted = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_LAST_INTERACTED);
1479 u32 oldDir;
1480 int x, y;
1481 int metatile;
1482
1483 if (*p_lastInteracted == NULL) {
1484 return FALSE;
1485 }
1486 oldDir = MapObject_GetFacingDirection(*p_lastInteracted);
1487 ov01_021F9408(*p_lastInteracted, rvsDir);
1488 if (MapObject_GetID(*p_lastInteracted) == obj_partner_poke) {
1489 if (ov01_022055DC(*p_lastInteracted) && oldDir != rvsDir) {
1490 ov01_02205604(*p_lastInteracted, &x, &y);
1491 metatile = GetMetatileBehavior(fieldSystem, x, y);
1492 if (rvsDir == 2 || rvsDir == 3) {
1493 if (MetatileBehavior_IsEncounterGrass(metatile) == TRUE) {
1494 ov01_021FF0E4(*p_lastInteracted, 0, x, y, 1);
1495 } else if (sub_0205B6F4(metatile) == TRUE) {
1496 ov01_021FF964(*p_lastInteracted, 0, x, y, 1);
1497 }
1498 }
1499 if (MetatileBehavior_IsEncounterGrass(metatile) == FALSE
1500 && sub_0205B6F4(metatile) == FALSE
1501 && sub_02060E54(*p_lastInteracted, metatile) == FALSE
1502 && sub_0205B984(metatile) == FALSE
1503 && sub_0205B7A4(metatile) == FALSE
1504 && sub_02060EBC(*p_lastInteracted, metatile) == FALSE
1505 && sub_0205B8AC(metatile) == FALSE
1506 && sub_0205BA70(metatile) == FALSE) {
1507 MapObject_ClearFlagsBits(*p_lastInteracted, MAPOBJECTFLAG_UNK20);
1508 }
1509 }
1510 }
1511 return FALSE;
1512}

3342BOOL ScrCmd_421(ScriptContext *ctx) {
3343 u16 r7 = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3344 u16 r4 = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3345 u16 r6 = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3346 u16 *p_ret_hi = GetVarPointer(ctx->fieldSystem, r4);
3347 u16 *p_ret_lo = GetVarPointer(ctx->fieldSystem, r6);
3348 u32 statval = GameStats_GetCapped(Save_GameStats_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData), r7);
3349 *p_ret_hi = (statval & 0xFFFF0000) >> 16;
3350 *p_ret_lo = statval & 0x0000FFFF;
3351 return FALSE;
3352}

3354BOOL ScrCmd_422(ScriptContext *ctx) {
3355 u16 statIdx = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3356 u16 value_hi = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3357 u16 value_lo = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
3358 u8 action = ScriptReadByte(ctx);
3359
3360 u32 value = (value_hi << 16) | value_lo;
3361 switch (action) {
3362 case 0:
3363 GameStats_Add(Save_GameStats_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData), statIdx, value);
3364 break;
3365 case 1:
3366 GameStats_SetCapped(Save_GameStats_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData), statIdx, value);
3367 break;
3368 case 2:
3369 GameStats_UpdateBounded(Save_GameStats_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData), statIdx, value);
3370 break;
3371 }
3372 return FALSE;
3373}

3389BOOL ScrCmd_SafariZoneAction(ScriptContext *ctx) {
3390 LocalFieldData *localFieldData = Save_LocalFieldData_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData);
3391 SaveVarsFlags *varsFlags = Save_VarsFlags_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData);
3392 SafariZone *safariZone = Save_SafariZone_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData);
3393 u8 action = ScriptReadByte(ctx);
3394 u8 areaSet = ScriptReadByte(ctx);
3395 u16 *p_nSafariBall = LocalFieldData_GetSafariBallsCounter(localFieldData);
3396 u16 *p_nSafariSteps = LocalFieldData_GetSafariStepsCounter(localFieldData);
3397 int r1;
3398
3399 switch (action) {
3400 case 0:
3401 Save_VarsFlags_SetSafariSysFlag(varsFlags);
3402 sub_0202F5F8(safariZone, areaSet);
3403 *p_nSafariBall = 30;
3404 *p_nSafariSteps = 0;
3405 break;
3406 case 1:
3407 Save_VarsFlags_ClearSafariSysFlag(varsFlags);
3408 sub_0202F5F8(safariZone, 1);
3409 r1 = SafariZone_GetLevel(safariZone);
3410 if (r1 != 0) {
3411 SaveData_SafariZone_CheckAreasWithUpdatedEncounters(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData, r1);
3412 SafariZone_SetLevel(safariZone, 0);
3413 }
3414 *p_nSafariBall = 0;
3415 *p_nSafariSteps = 0;
3416 break;
3417 }
3418 return FALSE;
3419}

4287
4288 Daycare *dayCare = Save_Daycare_Get(saveData);
4289 for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
4290 BoxPokemon *boxMon = DaycareMon_GetBoxMon(Save_Daycare_GetMonX(dayCare, i));
4291 if (GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) == SPECIES_ROTOM && !GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL)) {
4292 ret |= 1 << GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
4293 }
4294 }
4295
4296 PCStorage *pcStorage = SaveArray_PCStorage_Get(saveData);
4297 for (i = 0; i < (u32)NUM_BOXES; i++) {
4298 for (j = 0; j < MONS_PER_BOX; j++) {
4299 BoxPokemon *boxMon = PCStorage_GetMonByIndexPair(pcStorage, i, j);
4300 if (GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) == SPECIES_ROTOM && !GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL)) {
4301 ret |= 1 << GetBoxMonData(boxMon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
4302 }
4303 }
4304 }
4305
4306 Pokemon *walkerMon = AllocMonZeroed(HEAP_ID_FIELD3);
4307 BoxPokemon *walkerBoxMon = Mon_GetBoxMon(walkerMon);
4308 POKEWALKER *pokeWalker = Save_Pokewalker_Get(saveData);
4309 if (Pokewalker_TryGetBoxMon(pokeWalker, walkerBoxMon)) {
4310 if (GetBoxMonData(walkerBoxMon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL) == SPECIES_ROTOM && !GetBoxMonData(walkerBoxMon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL)) {
4311 ret |= 1 << GetBoxMonData(walkerBoxMon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
4312 }
4313 }
4314 Heap_Free(walkerMon);
4315
4316 return ret;
4317}

4375BOOL ScrCmd_FollowerPokeIsEventTrigger(ScriptContext *ctx) {
4376 u8 event = ScriptReadByte(ctx);
4377 u16 r7 = ScriptGetVar(ctx);
4378 u16 *r6 = ScriptGetVarPointer(ctx);
4379 Pokemon *mon;
4380 int species;
4381
4382 *r6 = 0;
4383 mon = Party_GetMonByIndex(SaveArray_Party_Get(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData), r7);
4384
4385 if (event >= NUM_EVENTS) {
4386 return FALSE;
4387 }
4388 if (GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL) || GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_CHECKSUM_FAILED, NULL)) {
4389 return FALSE;
4390 }
4391 if (!MonMetadataMatchesEvent(event, mon, GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_OT_ID, NULL) == PlayerProfile_GetTrainerID(Save_PlayerData_GetProfile(ctx->fieldSystem->saveData)))) {
4392 return FALSE;
4393 }
4394
4395 species = GetMonData(mon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
4396 switch (event) {
4397 case EVENT_SPIKY_EARED_PICHU:
4398 if ((species == SPECIES_PICHU || species == SPECIES_PIKACHU || species == SPECIES_RAICHU) && MonIsShiny(mon)) {
4399 *r6 = 1;
4400 }
4401 break;
4402 case EVENT_ARCEUS_HALL_OF_ORIGIN:
4403 case EVENT_ARCEUS_MOVIE_GIFT:
4404 if (species == SPECIES_ARCEUS) {
4405 *r6 = 1;
4406 }
4407 break;
4408 case EVENT_CELEBI:
4409 if (species == SPECIES_CELEBI) {
4410 *r6 = 1;
4411 }
4412 break;
4413 }
4414
4415 return FALSE;
4416}

5052static u32 GetMaxBankTransactionAmount(FieldSystem *fieldSystem, int action) {
5053 u32 ret;
5054 u32 wallet = PlayerProfile_GetMoney(Save_PlayerData_GetProfile(fieldSystem->saveData));
5055 u32 bank = PhoneCallPersistentState_MomSavings_BalanceAction(SaveData_GetPhoneCallPersistentState(fieldSystem->saveData), MOMS_BALANCE_GET, 0);
5056 switch (action) {
5057 case 0:
5058 ret = MAX_MONEY - bank;
5059 if (wallet <= ret) {
5060 ret = wallet;
5061 }
5062 break;
5063 case 1:
5064 ret = MAX_MONEY - wallet;
5065 if (bank <= ret) {
5066 ret = bank;
5067 }
5068 break;
5069 default:
5070 GF_ASSERT(FALSE);
5071 }
5072 return ret;
5073}

5077BOOL ScrCmd_BankTransaction(ScriptContext *ctx) {
5078 struct BankTransactionWork **p_work = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(ctx->fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_MISC_DATA_PTR);
5079 u16 mode = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
5080 u16 var_ret = ScriptReadHalfword(ctx);
5081 struct BankTransactionWork *work = *p_work = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_FIELD1, sizeof(struct BankTransactionWork)); // statement must be this way to match
5082 work->sub = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_FIELD1, sizeof(struct BankTransactionWorkSub));
5083 work->mode = mode;
5084 work->sub->max = GetMaxBankTransactionAmount(ctx->fieldSystem, mode);
5085 work->sub->selected = -1;
5086 ov01_021F6A9C(ctx->fieldSystem, 5, work->sub);
5087 ctx->data[0] = var_ret;
5088 SetupNativeScript(ctx, sub_020479D4);

5092BOOL sub_020479D4(ScriptContext *ctx) {
5093 struct BankTransactionWork **p_work = FieldSysGetAttrAddr(ctx->fieldSystem, SCRIPTENV_MISC_DATA_PTR);
5094 u16 *p_ret = GetVarPointer(ctx->fieldSystem, ctx->data[0]);
5095 struct BankTransactionWork *work = *p_work;
5096 if (work->sub->selected == -1) {
5097 return FALSE;
5098 } else if (work->sub->selected == 0) {
5099 *p_ret = 1;
5100 } else {
5101 SaveData *saveData = ctx->fieldSystem->saveData;
5102 switch (work->mode) {
5103 case 0:
5104 PlayerProfile_SubMoney(Save_PlayerData_GetProfile(saveData), work->sub->selected);
5105 PhoneCallPersistentState_MomSavings_BalanceAction(SaveData_GetPhoneCallPersistentState(saveData), MOMS_BALANCE_ADD, work->sub->selected);
5106 break;
5107 case 1:
5108 PlayerProfile_AddMoney(Save_PlayerData_GetProfile(saveData), work->sub->selected);
5109 PhoneCallPersistentState_MomSavings_BalanceAction(SaveData_GetPhoneCallPersistentState(saveData), MOMS_BALANCE_SUB, work->sub->selected);
5110 break;
5111 default:
5112 GF_ASSERT(FALSE);
5113 break;
5114 }
5115 *p_ret = 0;
5116 }
5117 Heap_Free(work->sub);
5118 Heap_Free(*p_work);
5119 return TRUE;
5120}
